subject: the work queue behind `feint coverage --evidence --gaps` (#408)
why: A score says where we stand; this says what to do next. Its whole value is that four zeros name four different jobs, so every mutation below turns the queue back into an undifferentiated list — which is the state it was built to replace, and which reads exactly the same to somebody who did not write it. Since 2026-08-24 it also separates work from decisions: the four mutations added last turn the `declared` kind back into an undifferentiated `undriven` backlog, honour a reason on an operation a client drives, strip the reason from the line, or cut the packs off as the source of reasons entirely.

mutations.expect: a defect stops outranking the rest, so an operation the record says broke its own contract is queued among the ones nobody ever drove
mutations.label: a defect no longer outranks the rest

mutations.expect: an operation no client reaches is filed as a recording session, so somebody records a cloud answer for a route nothing calls
mutations.label: an undriven operation is filed as a recording

mutations.expect: the queue sorts alphabetically, which hands one list to three people with three different jobs
mutations.label: the queue sorts alphabetically

mutations.expect: an operation no pack claims is queued under whichever provider sorts first, so a reader is sent to implement something in the wrong cloud
mutations.label: an unclaimed operation is queued under the wrong cloud

mutations.expect: the JSON publishes kinds and never says what they mean, so every consumer that did not read this file invents its own reading
mutations.label: the JSON stops saying what a kind means

mutations.expect: a typo in --axis prints an empty queue, and 'no gap on that axis' reads exactly like 'there is no such axis'
mutations.label: an unknown axis prints an empty queue

mutations.expect: the reason a pack wrote at the route stops retiring its zero, so all 141 of them go back to asking for a conformance suite that no client exists to write
mutations.label: a declared reason stops retiring its zero

mutations.expect: a reason is honoured on an operation a client does drive, so a stale excuse — the exact thing TestEveryUndrivenOperationSaysWhy exists to reject — empties a real recording queue
mutations.label: a stale reason excuses an operation a client drives

mutations.expect: the queue calls an operation declared and never says on what grounds, so a decision it names is one no reader can re-examine without opening three pack files
mutations.label: a declared line stops carrying its reason

mutations.expect: no reason is ever read from the packs, so the split has no input and the guard's own non-vacuity check is what must catch it
mutations.label: the reasons are never read from the packs
